purpose: Two original promotional concept alternatives; no publishing or addon changes

alternatives.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create a finished premium promotional hero image for CraftDeja, a profession-leveling addon for World of Warcraft: Forever, intended as the first image in its CurseForge description. Wide landscape 16:9, high resolution, crisp professional German typography, readable when reduced to description-column width. Reference image 1 is the actual CraftDeja goblin mascot: retain his recognizable green skin, huge ears, swept black hair, brass goggles, cheeky grin, purple waistcoat, leather workshop apron, emerald details and wrench. Reference image 2 is the brand material reference: brass, dark metal, cyan/violet edge light, green energy. These are style/identity references, not edit targets. Fresh original composition. Colors: near-black smoky navy, vivid goblin emerald, warm brass/gold, selective cyan and violet highlights. Rich polished fantasy game illustration with restrained futuristic workshop technology, NOT generic space cyberpunk. Depict actual product pillars: price-aware skill routes, auction house versus vendor comparison, existing bag/bank supplies versus new purchases, recipe trainers/vendors and crafting station sources, a clear next-step guide from shopping/mail to crafting, optional alts/guild crafts. Represent all crafting professions with small understated tools/herbs/cloth/potions/ore motifs rather than imply Engineering only. No guaranteed cheapest route, invented percentage saving, guaranteed skillup, unattended auto-craft, fake review stars, medals, official Blizzard endorsement, download counts, fabricated UI screenshot or unverifiable claim. Native actions remain user controlled. Do not add a version number so the artwork is evergreen. No CurseForge or Blizzard logo. Elegant edge margins, distinct hierarchy, no tiny paragraphs, no clutter. Required small footer: 'Deutsch & English · Beta'.
CONCEPT A — cinematic mascot hero, emotional first impression. A large charismatic goblin craftsman on the RIGHT, leaning over a brass-and-smoke-glass workbench, holding his familiar wrench, knowingly pointing toward a luminous emerald skill-route ribbon winding between a little sack of coins, bank chest, recipe book and anvil. Warm sparks and restrained floating herb/ore/potion props, softly blurred workshop depth; strong silhouette. The LEFT has exceptionally clean negative space and editorial typography. Exact large title: 'CraftDeja'. Exact dominant benefit headline on two lines: 'Mehr Skill.' and 'Mehr Gold übrig.' Exact smaller qualifier: 'Dein Berufsplaner für WoW Forever'. Under it three compact, beautifully designed feature rows with icons and exact copy: 'AH-Preise vergleichen' / 'Vorräte clever nutzen' / 'Rezeptquellen finden'. Along bottom a dark translucent bar has three short equal feature labels with subtle thin separators: 'Klare Levelroute' / 'Ein Guide für jeden Schritt' / 'Twinks & Gilden-Crafts'. Include the exact footer. The title and two-line headline must read instantly before the details. Design should feel confident, playful and iconic rather than a dense product specification. The green crafting-action button motif may glow on the workbench but must not suggest an actual clickable button in the image. All text verbatim, accurate accents, no extra text.

Gezielt skillen.' A sophisticated brass-edged smoke-glass workshop console fills center; a beautiful luminous green ROUTE runs left to right through five large illustrative tokens with clear exact labels: 'Planen' (recipe book and skill path), 'Einkaufen' (auction coins and vendor balance), 'Vorräte' (bag and bank chest with ore/herbs), 'Lernen' (trainer recipe scroll and map pin), 'Herstellen' (anvil, potion and sewing tools). Small actual mascot from reference stands near lower-left console edge, identifiable and cheekily presenting the route, occupying only 15–20% of the composition. At the bottom three spacious feature plaques, each with one exact short heading: 'Preise im Blick' / 'Nächster Schritt klar' / 'Twinks & Gilde dabei'.
